html.Jak funguje fotka zdarma?: How does the free photo work?
html.Nahrajete fotky jednoho produktu, vybere: Upload photos of one product, choose a setting, and within 24 hours I’ll email you a finished on-model photo. It’s free, has no watermark and you can use it straight away. The offer is valid once per store.
html.Kolik stojí AI fotky oblečení?: How much do AI clothing photos cost?
html.U 1–10 fotek 99 Kč za fotku, v balíčku K: For 1–10 photos it’s 99 CZK per photo, in the Collection package (11–50 photos) 69 CZK per photo, and above 50 photos by agreement. Prices are final. For comparison, a traditional model shoot costs roughly 500–1,000 CZK per photo.
html.Po schválení náhledů vám pošlu fakturu j: Once you’ve approved the previews, I’ll send you an invoice for the approved photos only. I’m not registered for VAT, so the prices on the website are final. You’ll receive the full-resolution photos without a watermark after payment.
html.Co když se mi fotky nebudou líbit?: What if I don’t like the photos?
html.Platíte jen za fotky, které schválíte. N: You only pay for the photos you approve. You’ll get watermarked previews first. Anything you don’t like, I’ll adjust – or you simply don’t pay for it.
html.Zkušební fotku do 24 hodin, kolekci do 2: The trial photo within 24 hours, a collection within 2–3 working days of receiving your photos. For larger orders, we’ll agree on a deadline in advance.
html.Jak mám produkt nafotit?: How should I photograph my product?
html.Stačí mobil a denní světlo. Vyfoťte celý: A phone and daylight are enough. Photograph the whole piece on a hanger, on a mannequin or laid flat, ideally against a light background and without filters. If the product has an interesting detail, add a photo of that too.
html.Změní AI barvu nebo střih produktu?: Will the AI change the colour or cut of my product?
html.Nemělo by se to stát. Každou fotku před: It shouldn’t happen. Before sending, I compare every photo with the original – the cut, colour, pattern and details. If something doesn’t match, I fix it. And if it can’t be fixed, you don’t pay for that photo. For small logos and fine lace, it helps to send a close-up as well.
html.Nebude to vypadat uměle? Pozná zákazník,: Won’t it look artificial? Will customers be able to tell it’s AI?
html.Fotky jsou fotorealistické a u každé pře: The photos are photorealistic, and before sending each one I check the hands, fabric, lighting and background. Judge for yourself from the examples above, or get one photo made for free. Customers shouldn’t be able to tell, but they will know: AI photos need to be labelled in your store (see below).
html.Umíte i pánskou a dětskou módu nebo plus: Do you also do menswear, kidswear or plus size?
html.Ano. Dělám fotky pro dámskou, pánskou i: Yes. I create photos for womenswear, menswear and kidswear on different body types including plus size, in multiple poses and angles (front, back, close-up), as well as for accessories such as shoes, handbags or jewellery.
html.Bude modelka vypadat stále stejně?: Will the model always look the same?
html.Ano. V balíčku Kolekce a vyšším udržím s: Yes. In the Collection package and above, I keep the same model face across all photos so that your brand looks consistent and professional.
html.Proč si to neudělám sám v AI aplikaci?: Why not do it myself in an AI app?
html.Můžete. Běžné aplikace ale často změní s: You can. But typical apps often change the cut, pattern or colour, and then every photo looks different. With me you get a faithful product, the same model across the whole collection and a manual check of every photo. You don’t have to fine-tune AI prompts, and you get an invoice.
html.Můžu fotky používat komerčně?: Can I use the photos commercially?
html.Ano. Fotky můžete bez omezení používat k: Yes. You can use the photos commercially without restriction – in your store, on marketplaces, on social media and in advertising. I won’t use them anywhere else without your consent.
html.Je v pořádku používat AI modelky na e-sh: Is it OK to use AI models in an online store?
html.Ano. Modelky jsou vygenerované, takže ne: Yes. The models are generated, so you don’t have to deal with model contracts or image rights. Since August 2026, AI photos in online stores need to be labelled, typically with a visible badge or a caption next to the photo. I’ll advise you on how.
html.Co se stane s nahranými fotkami?: What happens to the photos I upload?
html.Ukládají se do zabezpečeného soukromého: They are stored in secure private storage and I use them only to create your photos. I never publish them, and if we don’t start working together, they are automatically deleted within 90 days at the latest.
